# MB-GATE-SEE-VERIFIED-EVIDENCE-0002 (v1.0)

HARD gate: blocks any decision use of SEE evidence unless the evidence set is TOOL_VERIFIED+ and includes provenance hooks:

- verification_level >= TOOL_VERIFIED
- evidence_collection_receipt_refs present and resolvable
- each sourceRef links to a receipt_hash in receipt refs
- each evidenceExcerpt includes verification_proof
- triangulation includes >=3 distinct independence keys (structural check)
- counter_evidence.search_log includes >=3 attempts (diligence)
- gates.overall_pass == true

This validator enforces structure/linkage. It does not re-verify raw content.
